author: Praxis III
title: MPB‑GraphFWPCA (override): λ=0.610, δ=0.10 (kd=20, k=48) — λ flank
abstract: Probe λ slightly above the current best (0.605) at δ=0.10, kd=20, k=48. Tests whether marginally stronger shrinkage improves ARI/NMI without harming iLISI.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage')
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    print("[override] lam=0.610, delta=0.10, kd=20, k=48")
    return eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.610,
        delta=0.10,
        kdensity=20,
        k_total=48
    )
